change.title: Make source observation rejection coverage resilient to fixture cardinality drift
change.summary: Removes a stale exact Rust test-ID count from the oversized source-observation regression. The test continues to derive its payload from the canonical identity fixture and proves the payload exceeds the default observation limit, is rejected as ADAPTER_MALFORMED without ACK, and is rejected before the outer timeout. This is a source-test-only correction and changes no runtime behavior, test identity, catalog, or gate selection.

basis: run-evidence, quality metadata, impact, inventory, and source-gate contract checks
